body:
Confirmed via the real GitHub Actions API that every release.yml run has failed since 2026-08-11 and the last real GitHub Release is from 2026-04-26. Root cause: commit f31cfcd wired main.c to GOLDENBAND's mesh rig, but release.yml's own gcc command was never updated to compile+link packages/goldenband's sources -- undefined reference at link time. tests.yml already had the correct fix since 2026-08-20 (e807597a); release.yml just drifted out of sync. Reproduced the exact failure and fix locally with a real mingw-w64 build before trusting it in CI.

⚓ ☃
title: release.yml build break fixed: GOLDENBAND mesh-rig sources missing from Windows Client link, ~4 months of stale releases
